manufacturer.name: Cherubini
manufacturer.note: Italian manufacturer of tubular motors for roller shutters, awnings and blinds. Its instructions are served as static PDFs under files/uploads/istruzioni, year-foldered; that directory is registered as a harvest target. Search results name cherubini.it as a contact domain, but every URL that surfaced is cherubini-group.com, so that is what is recorded.

documents.title: Cherubini Roller Installation Instructions (EN)
documents.evidence: On cherubini-group.com, the manufacturer's own domain, in its standard-instructions tree. Document codes A4516 and 6R51 and the EN language are read from the file name; the 2023 folder is the edition year the manufacturer filed it under. Not fetched - egress blocked.
